## About
Your Neighborhood Auto Service is a family owned and operated repair shop on Grace Ln in Costa Mesa. Being privately owned means we get to know the people we work for, and their cars, over the long haul.
Our technicians are ASE certified and have decades of experience. We use quality parts, keep records of your vehicle's maintenance, and our shop has the equipment to check your car's vitals so diagnosis goes faster and you're back on the road sooner.
Questions about your car? Call Jack at (714) 549-8334 or stop by our shop on Grace Ln, near Baker St and Bristol St.

## Services
- Routine oil change: Every routine oil change includes a full 21 point inspection, so we can catch needed repairs or mileage related services early.
- Smog check test and repairs: California smog checks, plus repairs if your car needs work to pass.
- Brake jobs: Front or rear brake work, along with calipers, hoses and brake fluid flushes.
- Air conditioning service and repairs: Finding and fixing A/C problems so you stay cool on the drive.
- Check engine light: Bring it in when that light on your dash comes on and we'll find out why.
- Used car inspections: Thinking of buying a used car? We'll inspect it and give you a report.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on both foreign and domestic cars?
A: Yes. We do complete auto repair for foreign and domestic vehicles.

Q: Can you work on Mercedes Benz models?
A: Yes. We have dedicated diagnostic equipment for Mercedes Benz models.

Q: Where are you located?
A: We're on Grace Ln in Costa Mesa, south of the 405 and west of the 55 and 73, near Baker St and Bristol St.
